title: Give OLY-5-07 a mechanism: steward proposals need general evidence
summary: Add a rule in the steward's validate_item (crates/athena-core/src/steward.rs) that refuses a non-blind-spot improvement proposal citing fewer than two distinct evidence references, so a one-off is not treated as a general weakness. Record it in docs/spec.toml as OLY-5-07's mechanism with a measure ending `status: not shown` and the test that shows it. The audience is the Athena owner and the verifier judging the spec row.

defaults_applied.how: New unit test, clippy and fmt required
Rule enforced in validate_item rather than prose
One check, one test, one spec row
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/steward.rs (ProposedChange, validate_items, validate_item, check_reference), crates/athena-core/src/admission.rs, and crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs (measure validation at ~1218). The entry point is validate_items, which calls validate_item per item. Source and evidence references are checked with check_reference, then the rung and request checks run. No record or data file under crates/ is added, so check_record_file, AnyRecord and the round-trip test are not affected. The property is measured directly by calling validate_item or validate_items in unit tests.

Existing code: extends crates/athena-core/src/steward.rs (validate_item, whose evidence-required check already exists) and docs/spec.toml, whose OLY-5-06 row already points at steward.rs. Nothing new is created.

Interpretation: 'demonstrated general weakness' is mechanized as two or more distinct evidence references, and 'narrowest change' is already served by the single-rung ProposedChange. The first is an assumption the owner may correct.
Environment: none; no CI workflow, push or history read is involved.
No governance file (athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows) needs to change.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/spec.toml requirement OLY-5-07 has a mechanism that names validate_item in crates/athena-core/src/steward.rs (no longer "none"), owner "Athena", and a measure ending `status: not shown` that names the test, e.g. `cargo test -p athena-core steward`. Check with Grep on docs/spec.toml.

validate_item in crates/athena-core/src/steward.rs rejects a repeated-failure or proposal item whose evidence holds fewer than two distinct references, with a reason that names the key and says one instance is not a general weakness. It accepts the same item with two distinct references. Blind spots are exempt. Run `cargo test -p athena-core steward`.

A new steward unit test fails when the new check is removed: a single-evidence item is rejected with the new reason, and a duplicated reference counts once. It passes with the check. Run `cargo test -p athena-core steward`.

Existing steward tests and fixtures that build valid items with one evidence reference are updated to cite two, and the whole workspace passes: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets`, `cargo test --workspace`.

The newly refused share is expected at 0% of newly refused readings, because the rule applies only to steward proposals and not to readings or admission. The record-validation allow-list is untouched, since no record or data file is added.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry for the new rule. The spec.toml status-measure validation in crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs still accepts the measure.

out_of_scope: Changing admission, reading checks or the replay refusal rules
hard_reason: Adds a rule that can refuse steward proposals, which is part of the improvement authority boundary.
